reason: The plugin primarily enables file attachment and document processing for an agent, including content detection, Markdown conversion, OCR, image explanation, and paged document reading.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供文件上传、附件引用、文档转Markdown、图片OCR及分页读取能力。
summaries.en: Provides agent-oriented file uploads, attachment references, document-to-Markdown conversion, image OCR, and paged document reading.

capabilities: Accepts files and folders through picker, drag-and-drop, paste, and multi-file upload
Stores uploaded files in session-scoped local storage with size and lifetime limits
Detects file content and converts supported documents to Markdown
Performs image OCR and optionally requests image descriptions or audio transcription through configured model endpoints
Provides an agent-facing read_document tool with paging and caching
